{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue and filter out QA orders
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from analysis
analysis_data = completed[~completed.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Compute overall conversion rates for each channel
email_conv_rate = analysis_data[analysis_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv_rate = analysis_data[analysis_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
difference = email_conv_rate - paid_search_conv_rate

print("Overall email conversion rate:", email_conv_rate)
print("Overall paid_search conversion rate:", paid_search_conv_rate)
print("Difference (email - paid_search):", difference)"}
